Agent Name: WebServing_Expert  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert incorrectly identified the White House as the landmark featured on the August 2021 Vogue cover. The actual landmark in the background of the cover is the Washington Monument, as the photo of First Lady Jill Biden was taken in front of the White House with the Washington Monument visible in the background. This incorrect identification of the landmark led to the wrong height being calculated and ultimately resulted in the wrong solution to the problem.
